name: Diyanet Prayer Times
description:
Shows a countdown to the next prayer in the top bar (e.g. "Asr in 0.20.35") and today's prayer times with the Hijri date in a menu. Times come from the Turkish Presidency of Religious Affairs (Diyanet) or are calculated by Aladhan. Turkish and English.

Unofficial; not affiliated with Diyanet. Network use: Diyanet times are fetched through the author's proxy (nilsaver.abdullahnil.com) using the selected city id; Aladhan (api.aladhan.com) receives the selected coordinates; city search uses Open-Meteo (geocoding-api.open-meteo.com). Times are cached locally, so requests are made about once a month. No tracking.

Panelde bir sonraki namaz vaktine geri sayım (örn. "İkindiye 0.20.35") ve günün vakitlerini gösterir. Kaynak: Diyanet veya Aladhan.
